dialogue.content: こんばんは。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for being here.

dialogue.content: こんばんは！よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Good evening! Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: もうご準備はよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you ready to begin?

dialogue.content: はい！はじめてで不手際もあると思いますがよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes! This is my first time, so I might be a little awkward, but please bear with me.

dialogue.content: はい、よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Of course, thank you for being here.

dialogue.content: それでは始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Alright, let's get started.

dialogue.content: はーい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm your counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 職場の上司の愚痴が酷いんです
dialogue.English: My supervisor at work complains excessively.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。それは悩んでしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very troubling for you.

dialogue.content: 気に入らない人に対しては何でも許せないらしくて
dialogue.English: It seems they can't forgive anything when it comes to people they don't like.

dialogue.content: はじめに、性別と年齢をお聞きしてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: First, may I ask your gender and age?

dialogue.content: はい、35歳女です
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm a 35-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 職場でどのような愚痴で困っていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: What kind of complaints at work are troubling you?

dialogue.content: あいつは入社の時に自分から挨拶してこなかったからきっと性格が悪いとか
dialogue.English: Things like, 'That person must have a bad personality because they didn't greet me first when they joined the company.'

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 自分が担当の話を部署の別の人にしてくるなんてあいつらあたまがおかしいとか
dialogue.English: Or, 'Those people are crazy for talking to someone else in the department about something I'm in charge of.'

dialogue.content: ええ。
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: ちょい自分が不快に思っただけで相手を全否定するんですよね
dialogue.English: They completely dismiss someone just because of a minor annoyance.

dialogue.content: そんなこと言われるのは辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: It must be tough to hear things like that.

dialogue.content: 私は言われてないけど聞いてるだけでもこっちも不快というかいや、いないところで言われてるかもしれないんですけどね笑
dialogue.English: It's not directed at me, but just listening to it makes me uncomfortable. Well, maybe they're saying things about me behind my back too, haha.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。それを聞いているだけでも嫌な気持ちになってしましますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. Even just hearing it can make you feel unpleasant.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよねー
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: まあ、私も上司にわざわざ口答えしてないから同類なのかなって
dialogue.English: Well, I don't talk back to my supervisor, so maybe that makes me just as bad.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。入社の時からのことを、愚痴を言われているようですが、何か言われるようなきっかけなどありましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like you're being complained about regarding things from when you first joined. Was there some kind of incident that triggered this?

dialogue.content: あー私が言われてるわけじゃないんです😅
dialogue.English: Oh, I'm not the one they're complaining about. 😅

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。
dialogue.English: Oh, I see.

dialogue.content: ある人が入社時に自分に挨拶しなかったって愚痴を言うんです
dialogue.English: They complain that a certain person didn't greet them when they joined the company.

dialogue.content: そんなのアンタが挨拶すりゃいいじゃん
dialogue.English: I just want to say, 'Why don't you just greet them first?'

dialogue.content: って言えないんですよねー
dialogue.English: But I can't say that, you know?

dialogue.content: それは失礼いたしました。
dialogue.English: My apologies, I misunderstood.

dialogue.content: いえいえ
dialogue.English: No, no, it's fine.

dialogue.content: 上司が、他の人に対して愚痴を言ってくるのですね。
dialogue.English: So your supervisor complains to you about other people.

dialogue.content: そうですそうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's exactly right.

dialogue.content: それをあなたが聞いている立場でのお話なのですね。
dialogue.English: And you're in the position of having to listen to it.

dialogue.content: そうそう
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: その上司はいつも同じことを言ってくるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does your supervisor always say the same things repeatedly?

dialogue.content: そうですね、けっこう繰り返します
dialogue.English: Yes, they repeat themselves quite a lot.

dialogue.content: それはしんどいですよね。
dialogue.English: That must be exhausting.

dialogue.content: 今コロナ禍でしょ？
dialogue.English: We're in the middle of the COVID pandemic, right?

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 感染対策重要しゃないですか
dialogue.English: Infection control is important, isn't it?

dialogue.content: じゃないですか
dialogue.English: Isn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですよね。
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: なのに、気に入らない人からあの対面に置くクリアスタンドわかります？
dialogue.English: And yet, you know those clear partitions you put on desks for face-to-face interactions?

dialogue.content: はい、飲食店にあるものですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, the kind you see in restaurants.

dialogue.content: はい、今あの仕切り客応対じゃ当たり前ですよね？
dialogue.English: Yes, nowadays, those partitions are standard for customer service, right?

dialogue.content: いまはそうですよね。
dialogue.English: They are now, yes.

dialogue.content: そうそう
dialogue.English: Right, right.

dialogue.content: あれを気に入らない上の人から設置しろって言われたのに
dialogue.English: Even though they were told to install them by a higher-up they don't like...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 本当社長命令になるまでしなかったんですよ
dialogue.English: ...they didn't do it until it became a direct order from the president.

dialogue.content: それはびっくりしてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: That's quite shocking.

dialogue.content: そうなの！
dialogue.English: I know!

dialogue.content: 気に入らないからってそこまでする？！って
dialogue.English: Like, you'd go that far just because you don't like someone?!

dialogue.content: 嫌な気持ちとコロナ対策は別じゃない？って
dialogue.English: Shouldn't personal feelings and COVID measures be separate things?

dialogue.content: そうですよね。
dialogue.English: You're right.

dialogue.content: お怒りはごもっともだと思います。
dialogue.English: I think your anger is completely justified.

dialogue.content: やっぱなるべくかかりたくないし
dialogue.English: After all, I don't want to get infected if possible.

dialogue.content: そういう気分になりますよね。
dialogue.English: I can understand why you'd feel that way.

dialogue.content: その上司は、いつもそんなマイペースなかんじなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is that supervisor always so set in their ways?

dialogue.content: かからないように自分が普段出歩かないとか対策してて、それでも今の日本の状態だとかかるかもしれないけど
dialogue.English: I've been taking precautions, like not going out much, to avoid getting infected. And even then, with the situation in Japan, I might still get it, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いやー他はすっごい機敏ですよ
dialogue.English: No, in other aspects, they're really quick and efficient.

dialogue.content: 厳しいところもありますよね。
dialogue.English: There can be some challenging aspects as well.

dialogue.content: 感覚が違うとストレスも溜まってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: When your sense of things differs, it can be stressful.

dialogue.content: そうなんですここまで気をつけててかかったらしょうがないって思えるけど、上司の気分で対策遅れてかかるとかほんと嫌だ
dialogue.English: Exactly. If I get sick after being this careful, I can accept it. But getting sick because my supervisor's mood delayed safety measures... that's just awful.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。やはり気になるところですよね。その上司は、あなただけではなく他の人にもそのような態度なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I agree, that's definitely a concern. Does this supervisor treat others the same way, not just you?

dialogue.content: 我慢させるってことですか？
dialogue.English: Do you mean, do they make others put up with it?

dialogue.content: うーん、自分より下にはそうじゃないかな
dialogue.English: Hmm, I think they are like that with people below them.

dialogue.content: いえ、違いますよ。
dialogue.English: No, that’s not what I meant.

dialogue.content: 我慢のことではないですね。
dialogue.English: It wasn't about enduring it.

dialogue.content: 他の人にも愚痴を言うか？
dialogue.English: You mean, do they complain to other people too?

dialogue.content: 言える人には言ってますね
dialogue.English: They do, to people they feel they can talk to.

dialogue.content: その上司は自分より年下には、そのようなマイペースな態度なのですね。
dialogue.English: So, the supervisor takes that self-centered attitude with people younger than them.

dialogue.content: あなた以外にも困っている人は多そうですよね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like there may be others besides you who are troubled by this.

dialogue.content: マイペースとは違うかな本当は機敏で仕事もできる人なんです
dialogue.English: I'm not sure if 'self-centered' is the right word. They're actually very quick and good at their job.

dialogue.content: 懐に入れた人は可愛がってるし実際私も可愛がってもらってる方だと思います
dialogue.English: They take good care of the people they've taken a liking to, and I think I'm actually one of the people they treat well.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。お仕事は出来ますが、コロナ対策のことにや、愚痴に対しては困っていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So, they are competent at their job, but you're troubled by their attitude towards COVID measures and their complaining.

dialogue.content: そう、大人としてそこはどうなの？ってか
dialogue.English: Yes, it's like, 'As an adult, is that really okay?'

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 周りも思ってる人いると思うんだよな
dialogue.English: I think others around us feel the same way.

dialogue.content: 大人として気になるところはあるのですね。
dialogue.English: So there are aspects of their behavior that concern you, from an adult perspective.

dialogue.content: その上司のことで他に困っていることはありますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else about this supervisor that is troubling you?

dialogue.content: 特にないです
dialogue.English: Not particularly.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 懐に入れてもらってる分
dialogue.English: Since I'm in their good graces,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 強く言えないところは悩みかな
dialogue.English: ...I guess my problem is that I can't speak up strongly.

dialogue.content: それは悪くいってはいけないかな、と思ってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: It makes you feel like you shouldn't speak ill of them, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: けど周りからしてみたら子分みたいに思われて
dialogue.English: But to others, I probably look like their little follower.

dialogue.content: ええ。それに上司だと気を使いますし、可愛がってくれている分、言いづらいところもありますよね。
dialogue.English: Yes. And they're your supervisor, so you have to be considerate, and the fact that they treat you well makes it even harder to say anything.

dialogue.content: はい、聞いていますよ。
dialogue.English: Yes, I’m listening.

dialogue.content: めっちゃ言いにくいですけど愚痴を言ってる彼女を否定しないから私も同類じゃん？って
dialogue.English: This is really hard to say, but since I don't challenge them when they complain, doesn't that make me just as bad?

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。ご自分も同じなのかもしれない、と思ってしまうのですね。
dialogue.English: I see—you find yourself wondering if you’re the same.

dialogue.content: 私も周りから同じ風にめんどくセーって思われてるのかな
dialogue.English: I wonder if others think I'm a pain in the neck, just like them.

dialogue.content: もしかして周りの方から、そのようなことを言われたことはあるのですか？
dialogue.English: Has anyone around you ever said something like that to you?

dialogue.content: 私個人ではないけどおたくの部署いつになったら対策するの？とは言われたかな😅
dialogue.English: Not to me personally, but I think someone did ask, 'When is your department going to implement the safety measures?' 😅

dialogue.content: 部署くくりにされて見られてるの嫌だなーって
dialogue.English: I hate being lumped together with the whole department like that.

dialogue.content: その上司とは同じ部署で、対策のことなどで誤解されたくはないですよね。
dialogue.English: You're in the same department as that supervisor, and you don't want to be misunderstood about things like the safety measures.

dialogue.content: そうそれに関しては私も嫌だからね
dialogue.English: Exactly—that’s something I really don’t like either.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。やらなければいけないことも、ありますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. There are things that need to be done.

dialogue.content: あーそうですね、上司の愚痴ってよりも周りから同じに見られるのが耐えられないかも
dialogue.English: Ah, yes, maybe it's not so much the supervisor's complaining, but more that I can't stand being seen as the same as them by others.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。同じ部署だと、対策についてやっていないと思われるのは辛いところですよね。
dialogue.English: I can see that. Being in the same department, it must be painful to be seen as not taking the safety measures seriously.

dialogue.content: あいつも常識ないとか思われたくない
dialogue.English: I don't want people to think I have no common sense, just like them.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。このことを他の誰かに相談したことはありますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Have you spoken to anyone else about this?

dialogue.content: ないです、課のボスに言ったらなんか伝わりそうで
dialogue.English: No, I'm afraid if I told the head of our section, it would get back to them.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。おひとりで悩みを抱えられていたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you've been dealing with this all by yourself.

dialogue.content: それは気が重くなってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: That must be a heavy burden to carry.

dialogue.content: けどもう伝わっちゃってもいいかな
dialogue.English: But maybe at this point, I don't care if it gets back to them.

dialogue.content: くだらないことならともかく感染対策はもう重要だし
dialogue.English: If it were something trivial, fine, but infection control is important now.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。そのようなお気持ちも、お持ちなのですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. So you're feeling that way as well.

dialogue.content: おっしゃる通り感染対策は、いまは必要なものかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: As you say, infection control measures are necessary right now.

dialogue.content: 私も愚痴周りに言われちゃうかな
dialogue.English: I wonder if they'll start complaining about me to others.

dialogue.content: それは心配になってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: That is a worrying thought.

dialogue.content: その課長のボスにすこし相談してみるのはできますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be possible for you to consult with your section boss a little?

dialogue.content: ふんふん
dialogue.English: Hmm.

dialogue.content: ↑課のボス　の間違いでした
dialogue.English: My mistake, I meant your section boss.

dialogue.content: できます、ボスは話通じるタイプですから
dialogue.English: I can. The boss is the type of person who listens.

dialogue.content: ただ、あっけらかんとしすぎてて内容そのまま相手に伝えそうなのがたまに傷
dialogue.English: The only drawback is that they're so frank, they might just repeat what I say directly to the person involved.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。他にだれか一緒に相談に行ってくれそうな方はいますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Is there anyone else who might go with you to talk to them?

dialogue.content: 人数少ないのでいないですね
dialogue.English: It's a small group, so no.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一人だと心細いところもあるかもしれませんが、報告というより相談がある、というニュアンスで行かれるのもいいかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: It might feel daunting to go alone, but perhaps framing it as seeking advice rather than making a report would be a good approach.

dialogue.content: あー密告みたいなのはイヤですもんね
dialogue.English: Ah, I see. I wouldn't want it to seem like I'm snitching.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: 告げ口ではなく、相談なら話を聞いてもらいやすいですし、なにかいい方法が見つかるかもしれませんよね。
dialogue.English: If it's a consultation rather than tattling, they might be more receptive, and you might find a good solution.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: とりあえず愚痴のことじゃなくて感染対策はちゃんとしたいって相談すればいいのかな
dialogue.English: So, for now, I should probably consult with them about wanting to implement proper infection control, rather than about the complaining.

dialogue.content: そうですね。それにその上司には可愛がってもらっている分、尊敬している部分もありますが、ただ気になるところを、すこし相談という形なら、あなたも話しやすいのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes, that sounds like a good idea. And since your supervisor treats you well, you have some respect for them, but if you frame it as just wanting to discuss a few concerns, it might be easier for you to talk about it.

dialogue.content: はい、感染対策のことの相談でいいとおもいますよ。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think consulting about the infection control measures is a good idea.

dialogue.content: そうですね、それはそうだ普段言い過ぎと思っても耐えれましたもんこれがコロナ禍、命に関わる事じゃなければ
dialogue.English: You're right, that’s true. Usually, even if I feel they go too far, I can tolerate it. But not during this pandemic, not when it’s a matter of life and death.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 必要になったら感染対策委員と上司の不仲について言えばいいのか
dialogue.English: And if necessary, I can bring up the bad blood between the infection control committee and my supervisor.

dialogue.content: はい、対策については早急に必要だと思われます。あなたの感覚は正しいですし、必要なことを相談することは悪いことではないと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: Yes, it seems that action on these measures is urgently needed. Your feelings are valid, and there's nothing wrong with consulting about something so necessary.

dialogue.content: うん、ありがとうございますなんか相談するイメージがわきました
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you. I have a clearer idea now of how to approach this consultation.

dialogue.content: やってみようと思います
dialogue.English: I think I'll give it a try.

dialogue.content: それはよかったです。あなたは、他の方に対する気遣いも出来る方だと思います。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that. I believe you are someone who is very considerate of others.

dialogue.content: そう言っていただけると嬉しいです！
dialogue.English: I'm happy to hear you say that!

dialogue.content: 必要な対策について、ぜひご相談なさってみてくださいね。
dialogue.English: Please do go ahead and consult with them about the necessary measures.

dialogue.content: はーい
dialogue.English: Okay!

dialogue.content: その会社もあなたのような方がいてくれれば、安心だと思いますよ。
dialogue.English: I think the company is lucky to have someone like you.

dialogue.content: そうだといいんですけど😅
dialogue.English: I hope so. 😅

dialogue.content: ぜひ、一歩前に進んでみてくださいね。
dialogue.English: Please, try to take that step forward.

dialogue.content: はーい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 今日ご相談はここまでで大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Will that be all for our session today?

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much!

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: それでは、ここで失礼いたします。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Alright then, I will conclude our session here. Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you again!

dialogue.content: それでは終了いたします！
dialogue.English: I will now end the session!
